content: Kriti Mahajan called insurance agent Anita Sharma to check on her auto policy (AP-001234), discovering it had lapsed due to a missed payment. Anita explained that the policy can be reinstated with a back premium of $150. Kriti agreed to pay the amount by the end of the day, and Anita confirmed the policy will be fully active and updated documents sent via email once processed.

action_items: Customer to pay the $150 back premium by the end of the day
Agent to process payment and send updated policy documents via email
